summary: This is an 8-K filing by CSAIL 2017-CX9 Commercial Mortgage Trust reporting a routine special servicer replacement. The Allergan HQ Mortgage Loan (5.2% of the asset pool) had its special servicer changed from Rialto Capital Advisors to Torchlight Loan Services, effective June 25, 2026, as permitted under the pooling and servicing agreement. There are no deal terms, price, premium, or any special-situation event such as acquisition, restructuring, or tender offer. This is an administrative servicer transition, not a corporate special situation.
